Ben/Marissa — draft guidance below; I'll push a doc to Drive and share link.

Key points for the annex:
- Define scope: telemetry & aggregated logs only; explicit exclusion of raw patient-identifiable fields.
- Timebox: customer-specified contiguous window, max 96 hours per incident unless mutually agreed extension.
- Retention: telemetry retained for diagnostics only and auto-deleted after 30 days; any backups excluded from cross-region replication.
- Subprocessor visibility: we will provide a scoped roster and notify customer 48 hours before the window if any additional subprocessors are involved.
- KMS: master keys remain in EU; telemetry keys are derived and logged — no extraction of master key material.
- Audit & evidence: we will produce an audit extract within 3 business days after the window ends.
- Remedies: audit rights and limited indemnities tied to operator error; no SLA credits for privacy controls.

I'll post a draft annex in Drive and flag the clauses we expect Helix legal to countersign. Once Ben confirms call time I'll prepare DocuSign-ready markup.

—Laura

Senior Counsel, Privacy & Contracts
